name: plan-pets-b
about: Test plan through the plan_pets bot, on a fresh LabPets with a Pet Shop pet at level 20 (hwp pet xp, pets.debug). pets s4: a pot beside the pet stays whole without Smash and breaks once a point is in. pets s5: Mend heals below 80 % hp and not above; Stun (rank 5) never stuns an elite bandit and stuns a goblin; Morale: the buff and its HUD icon out of combat, gone with an enemy within 350 px, back once it is dead. pets s2: the pet follows a walk, but with a vanilla puzzle (lights-out) at its end it waits outside without moving and follows again when the player comes out (querycmp in the note: what PetWait's QueryCircle sees of the puzzle buttons). petrooms: the same with a trap room (three pressure-plate spikes); and with petwait.radius 60, spikes put beside the pet (not the player) send it out of the room, where it waits until the player moves on.

steps.name: pet skills, puzzle and trap rooms
